inventory = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("inventory", range(1, horizon + 1), lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')

                <= start[(t2, i2)] + M * (1 - y[(t1, i1, t2, i2)]),
                f"R2_center_{c}_pair_{t1}_{i1}_{t2}_{i2}_1",

    # bounds will be enforced explicitly (R4) but also set here for safety
    u[i] = pulp.LpVariable(f"u_{i}", lowBound=2, upBound=4, cat="Integer")

# Objective: minimize total travel time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in nodes if j != i) == 1,
        f"R1_out_{i}"
